name: B10-0424/2026 – After recital N – Am 126
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: Nb. whereas equating religious activism or ideological strategies with terrorism results in a dangerous link that is legally baseless, as these phenomena do not constitute terrorist acts under EU law; whereas such confusion undermines religious freedom and the rule of law;
